original_prompt:
Create ONE clean labelled modular game architecture reference sheet on plain light ivory paper, crisp detailed studio illustration, soft even lighting, no landscape or complete building scene, no people, no perspective distortion. Use ONLY the single supplied B02 source panel as visible architectural authority. Retain its pearl/ivory marble, restrained blush veins, gold filigree, pale amber/lilac and sky glazing, WHITE PEARL onion roofs and slender minarets. No purple roof, no giant main-palace rose Gothic windows. Isolate full uncropped components with space between cells. Show real depth and matching unobstructed joining faces. Names and FULL IDs below each item, dimensions described as PROPOSED. Dimensions below are width x depth x height, not existing measured geometry. Each cell independent drawing scale. Do not add plants, water, lights, furnishings or ornament props not requested. Exactly TWELVE main objects in FOUR columns by THREE rows. Each small component entirely isolated, legible depth and useful small rear/top contact inset where helpful. IDs full B02-DETAIL-001-D01 through D12 in numeric order. No empty cells, no duplicated objects counted as extra assets. Clean precise gold linework, no melty tendrils; patterned lattices consistent. Title B02-DETAIL-001. Footer "Removable details / flat backs and join faces / proposed dimensions".

review_notes: Twelve labelled main groups appear in4columns by3rows. Revision removes rail end posts, removes the tiny dome under D10 and changes D08 rear view to a lotus silhouette. These improve part separation, without proving exact view parity.

D01 lattice remains an intricate illustrative pattern, not a validated seamless repeat. D08 front/back petals remain approximate; reconstruct a single outline for the actual mesh. Small D10 socket insets also need parity review.

D03 is a smaller cusped surround proposal, not a proven fit to the large arcade opening. D02 and D09 glazing must be resized from locked host apertures; maintain lower portal passage. D04/D05 and D06/D07 profile joins, D12 curvature, repeat motifs and attachment surfaces remain unverified.
